core_meaning.primary_meaning: Giath is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Succour, aid”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Giath corresponds to the Arabic form غياث (Arabic root غ و ث (gh-w-th); غياث (Ghiyāth)). Its core sense is succour, aid, relief. Giath is best identified with غياث (Ghiyāth) 'succour, aid' — the same name as ghiyas/ghiyath in this batch. The source gave جث (a bare root fragment, not the name) and glossed it 'powerful, valiant', neither of which matches; both were corrected. The identification is recorded at medium confidence because the source columns are corrupt.
